findings: claude-cli (oauth_token, in container): all nine mandatory probes pass on the pinned image sha256:f642e03d19ba… over the qualified egress profile. The turn reached only api.anthropic.com:443; the sidecar refused the CLI's telemetry target (http-intake.logs.us5.datadoghq.com:443) and example.com:443, and a direct attempt without the proxy failed at DNS.

cancel_tree: docker stop (SIGTERM through --init) ended a running Bash turn in under a second with exit 143. crash_recovery: SIGKILL (exit 137) mid-turn, then --resume with the exact prior session id answered from that session's history.
filesystem_containment: root read-only, /workspace the only writable bind, no /Users, no docker socket, /root read-only and empty, uid 65534; the turn wrote only .probe (the probe's own file).
container image tools are newer than the host binaries (claude 2.1.278 vs host 2.1.267); the pin that matters is the image digest.

secret_isolation: the OAuth token is absent from the stream, stderr, workspace, sidecar log, argv and the worker-owned session home. It is present in the container's environment by construction (the CLI needs it); docker inspect on the host can read it, which is host authority, not agent-visible output. A credential broker (V3-022) remains the production answer.
trust class: artifacts are admitted as operator trust (this session measured and graded them). They are not an independent verifier result; the human cutover gate (V3-062) still applies.
review R1 (contract lens): cancel_tree now also requires exit code 143 (SIGTERM honoured) so a container that died for another reason within the window cannot pass.

codex-cli (ChatGPT account via a user-prepared scoped copy of auth.json as the sandbox HOME, gpt-5.6-sol): all nine mandatory probes pass in the container. The turn reached only chatgpt.com:443; the sidecar refused ab.chatgpt.com:443 and the statsig/telemetry targets. The credential is present in the worker-owned session home by construction (that is how codex authenticates) and absent from stream, stderr, workspace, sidecar log and argv.

cancel_tree semantics: codex handles SIGTERM with a graceful exit 0 while claude exits 143; the probe passes only when the stream carries no completion event, the container is gone within 10 s and the exit code is 0 or 143.
codex-cli in-container versions: image codex-cli 0.155.1 vs host 0.154.0; the image digest is the pin.
method: scripts/container_qualify.py: real turns inside the pinned image on the qualified egress profile; QualificationRunner with CAS-admitted artifacts (operator trust: self-measured, not an independent verifier); status fail unless all nine pass

cost_summary.claude-cli: 2 completed turns + 2 interrupted turns per run; last run pong=5 out tokens
